full_request: 덕테이프 포스터를 만들어줘. 문구는 “서로 다른 속도”만 넣어줘. 어떤 느낌으로 할지는 맡길게.

requirements.style:
덕테이프 포스터를 만들어줘. 문구는 “서로 다른 속도”만 넣어줘. 어떤 느낌으로 할지는 맡길게.

Literal client styles:
{"mode": "open", "exact_request": "어떤 느낌으로 할지는 맡길게."}

Literal mandatory client conditions:
Print the supplied title once with intact readable Hangul; no other copy, logos, labels or watermarks.
Each output is a separate single flat opaque poster, portrait 2:3.
All five must have a substantive content-grounded non-glyph visual concept. Type/whitespace-only or tiny ornament, backgroundtexture/gradient/wallpaper, or3Dlettering-alone loopholes are prohibited.
Styles are open; subject relationships, typography and spatial organization must distinguish all five, not color/filter variants.
